usage: fitr run <model> [--quick|--full|--checks-only]
  --allow-unsafe-exec run unisolated built-in executable diagnostics;
    observations remain INCONCLUSIVE
  --backend auto|ollama|llama-server|openai
  --capacity-budget-gb seal an operator-supplied safe memory budget; never
    inferred from nominal capacity
  --capacity-reserve-gb subtract an explicit reserve from current available
    memory and seal the exact formula
  --checks-only generated checks only for paired hardware calibration
  --context-tiers two to four increasing payload sizes in bytes (2048 to 65536),
    measuring how well a long document is used at --ctx. There is no default:
    the tiers are sealed into the evidence, so the operator states what was
    tested
  --ctx request context (default 8192). Apply an advise num_ctx remedy here.
  --display auto|rich|plain|json|none
  --full adds the long-horizon agent task; executable tasks use bubblewrap on
    Linux when it is available
  --html write a self-contained HTML artifact next to the JSON
  --k repeats per noisy task
  --profile device profile (default: auto-match)
  --pull pull the model first if it is not installed (Ollama; supports hf.co/...
    and Hugging Face repository URLs)
  --q quiet level
  --quick speed, memory, and plumbing; executable tasks use bubblewrap on Linux
    when it is available
  --seedset pin the generated-instance seed set; two runs sharing a seedset face
    IDENTICAL task instances, enabling a paired comparison
  --v verbose
